items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: They had another great drummer named T. Marcel.

ctx.x: And they had brought up Ti-Ro-Ro, which is one of the greatest drummers for Haiti. They say he's the greatest drummer because they have six different rites there, like the Bushmen and all, and he can play in the language of all of their rites, the ceremonies. And that's why they call him the greatest drummer. They had another great drummer named T. Marcel.
